lessons.title: Full-frame streaming can tear capture evidence
lessons.context: Runtime attempted to cycle four full-world frames by reloading a large camera tile cache.
lessons.observation: Short-warmup BlastEm screenshots showed horizontal tile-cache tearing/corruption even after the PNG reconstruction and exported bins were correct.
lessons.diagnosis: Large code-driven tile uploads were observable by the emulator/capture before the tile graphics and tilemap reached a stable state.
lessons.resolution_or_preventive_heuristic: Batch tile uploads through a RAM staging buffer, disable display during scene-enter load, delay autopan, and keep `FRAME_ANIMATION_ENABLED=0` until incremental/double-buffered streaming is implemented.
scope_limits: This fixes evidence stability for the lab viewer; it does not establish a production streaming engine.

canonical_patch_proposal.summary: Keep local until an existing owner or reusable procedural gap is proven.

lessons.title: Global ROM tiles are not resident VDP budget
lessons.context: Full-world Showdown export produced 2253 global unique ROM tiles, which cannot be claimed as a simple full-resident VDP fit.
lessons.observation: Treating all unique world tiles as resident would either exceed practical VDP layout expectations or obscure the difference between ROM storage and live VRAM cache.
lessons.diagnosis: Dedup metrics were initially read as a direct resident-budget claim instead of a source/export metric.
lessons.resolution_or_preventive_heuristic: Report global ROM tiles separately from active-window unique tiles. The viewer now streams a 42x30 window with max observed active unique tiles 1087 and cache capacity 1151, while `validado_budget` remains false until VDP dump/telemetry exists.
scope_limits: This is a budget-audit pattern, not proof of runtime performance.

canonical_patch_proposal.summary: Keep local until an existing owner or reusable procedural gap is proven.

lessons.title: MUGEN stage composition is execution, not metadata
lessons.context: showdown.sff/showdown.def reconstruction for work/reconstructed_layers/frame_0000.png before SGDK export.
lessons.observation: The previous reconstructed frames contained a large solid magenta matte and displaced layers even though SFF/DEF properties were parsed.
lessons.diagnosis: The renderer treated the DEF as metadata instead of executing MUGEN 2D composition rules: SFF axes, PCX index-0 alpha, BG order, start offsets, animation offsets and tiling.
lessons.resolution_or_preventive_heuristic: Convert masked PCX sprites to RGBA with palette index 0 alpha 0, compose with alpha paste, draw BG sections in DEF order, apply start/offset/axis/tile rules, then run the anti-magenta histogram gate before SGDK binary export.
scope_limits: Local training evidence only; this is not a canonical parser promotion.

canonical_patch_proposal.summary: Keep local until an existing owner or reusable procedural gap is proven.

lessons.title: SGDK viewer palettes must not overwrite stage palettes
lessons.context: sgdk_viewer/showdown_viewer rendered the reconstructed Showdown bins in BlastEm.
lessons.observation: The viewer loaded stage palettes and then reused PAL3 for debug text, corrupting foreground colors.
lessons.diagnosis: Template/debug UI assumptions leaked into a full-screen art viewer where all four subpalettes are part of the asset contract.
lessons.resolution_or_preventive_heuristic: Do not reserve PAL0-PAL3 for debug text after loading full-screen stage palettes; keep debug text out of the palette contract or use a separate validated presentation path.
scope_limits: Applies to full-screen code-loaded art fixtures using all four MD subpalettes.

canonical_patch_proposal.summary: Keep local until an existing owner or reusable procedural gap is proven.

lessons.title: Viewport crop is not stage conversion
lessons.context: Showdown DEF camera bounds are larger than the Mega Drive viewport: world 768x480, viewport 320x224.
lessons.observation: A 40x28/320x224 reconstruction made the SGDK viewer easier to build but lost the original MUGEN stage extent and hid the need for camera management.
lessons.diagnosis: The conversion treated the display viewport as the source world instead of deriving the world from `boundleft`, `boundright`, `boundhigh` and `boundlow`.
lessons.resolution_or_preventive_heuristic: Reconstruct full-world frames, export 96x60 tilemaps, and make the SGDK viewer manage camera/streaming. Use viewport previews only as evidence, not as source data.
scope_limits: Local training evidence only. Exact MUGEN parallax/delta behavior still needs additional curation.

canonical_patch_proposal.summary: Keep local until an existing owner or reusable procedural gap is proven.

lessons.title: mugen_stage_full_world_camera_streaming_fixture
lessons.observation: Derive the full stage world from MUGEN DEF camera bounds, export global ROM tiles and a world tilemap, then use a SGDK camera/window-streamed viewer instead of resizing to the Mega Drive viewport.
lessons.diagnosis: This prevented a false 320x224 conversion from hiding the actual 768x480 stage and made camera/budget tradeoffs explicit.
scope_limits: Not promoted. Needs at least two additional MUGEN stages, an explicit parallax/delta model, VDP dump/telemetry, and a production-safe incremental streaming strategy before any canonical skill/tool change.

canonical_patch_proposal.summary: Evaluate whether a new skill is justified: mugen_stage_full_world_camera_streaming_fixture

lessons.title: mugen_stage_logical_composition_gate
lessons.observation: Parse DEF stage instructions, apply SFF axes, apply PCX index-0 alpha, compose layers in engine order, support tiling, then run a matte/magenta histogram gate before any SGDK export.
lessons.diagnosis: This prevented a catastrophic magenta matte regression from being hidden by later tile/bin/ROM steps.
scope_limits: Not promoted. Before canonical promotion, compare against at least two more SFF v1 stages, define mask inference policy, and decide how to represent palette degradation separately from hard palette violations.

canonical_patch_proposal.summary: Evaluate whether a new skill is justified: mugen_stage_logical_composition_gate

lessons.title: Anti-magenta gate before tile export
lessons.context: Showdown reconstruction produces work/reconstructed_layers/frame_0000.png through frame_0003.png before SGDK export.
lessons.observation: A visual histogram gate rejected solid magenta or transparent matte leakage before the tile/bin/ROM stage could hide the root cause.
lessons.resolution_or_preventive_heuristic: Count exact magenta, near-magenta and transparent pixels in the 320x224 reconstructed frame and fail export when the bad-pixel ratio exceeds 5 percent.
scope_limits: This gate detects catastrophic matte leakage, not palette quality or artistic fidelity.

canonical_patch_proposal.summary: Local success note; no canonical change proposed.

lessons.title: Evidence-friendly streaming hold
lessons.context: The BlastEm capture tool may take its screenshot after several seconds of emulation, while large tile uploads can still be visually unstable if the camera/animation is moving.
lessons.observation: The final evidence starts on the canonical Showdown view and avoids tile tearing.
lessons.resolution_or_preventive_heuristic: Disable frame animation, batch upload active-window tiles, disable the display during scene-enter load, and delay autopan for 1800 ticks while keeping D-pad camera available.
scope_limits: This is a training viewer evidence pattern, not a substitute for production streaming telemetry.

canonical_patch_proposal.summary: Local success note; no canonical change proposed.

lessons.title: Full-world tilemap plus camera viewer
lessons.context: Showdown camera bounds produce a 768x480 stage world, larger than the 320x224 Mega Drive viewport.
lessons.observation: The viewer can now display the stage as a large tilemap with a managed camera instead of relying on a resized/cropped PNG reconstruction.
lessons.resolution_or_preventive_heuristic: Reconstruct 768x480 frames, export 96x60 maps, keep global ROM tile IDs in a custom map format, stream a 42x30 active window into VDP, and document camera bounds in the root manifest.
scope_limits: Lab proof only. Budget is estimated and parallax is flattened.

canonical_patch_proposal.summary: Local success note; no canonical change proposed.

lessons.title: Root-owned evidence chain for nested viewer
lessons.context: sgdk_viewer/showdown_viewer remains nested, but the study root owns the ROM hash, reports and BlastEm evidence.
lessons.observation: The viewer stopped being an orphan proof because root manifests connect source inputs, reconstruction reports, SGDK bins, ROM and emulator screenshot.
lessons.resolution_or_preventive_heuristic: Keep doc/viewer_aggregate_manifest.json, doc/10-memory-bank.md, lab_report.json and doc/changelog/changelog.md aligned with the same ROM SHA256 and evidence files.
